label: Suitcase
depicts: Briefcase body with one top handle and two horizontal bands across the front panel
use_when: Use when the interface wants the luggage to feel flatter and more like a briefcase with front bands.
avoid_when: Do not use for the taller suitcase when the case should not be framed by two vertical side rails.

label: Sun
depicts: Round sun circle with short rays spaced evenly around the outer rim
use_when: Use when the interface wants the standard sun symbol with a central disk and evenly spaced rays.
avoid_when: Do not use for the wrapped sun when a sweeping ring line should cut through the disk from the left side.

label: Sun
depicts: Round sun disk crossed by one sweeping ring line that wraps through the left side
use_when: Use when the interface wants the sun to feel more stylized with a ring line sweeping through the disk.
avoid_when: Do not use for the classic sun when the icon should only rely on short rays around a plain center disk.

label: T Shirt
depicts: T shirt silhouette with short sleeves and side panels and one rounded collar opening
use_when: Use when the interface wants a fuller shirt body with extra side panel detail built into the silhouette.
avoid_when: Do not use for the plainer tee when the shirt should not emphasize extra side panels or outer seam structure.

label: T Shirt
depicts: Plain t shirt silhouette with short sleeves and one simple crew neck opening
use_when: Use when the interface wants the simplest tee outline without extra side panel structure or shaping.
avoid_when: Do not use for the paneled shirt when the body should show more structure around the sides and shoulders.
